items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: It was Louis Cloris Francis. Actually, the family name was Francoise, and when my father landed in Miami

ctx.x: It was Louis Cloris Francis. Actually, the family name was Francoise, and when my father landed in Miami, Florida, whoever it was that had his papers, wrote down "Francis", and so ever since then, the name has been Francis, but actually the family name was Francoise. Because my father was Haitian.
Yeah, you said when your father landed in Miami -- I want to know where did he come from. Your parents were what?
